longest_story.title: The Only Man Batman Ever Killed!
longest_story.script: David Vern (credited as David V. Reed)
longest_story.first_line: The horror of that night haunts him still...
longest_story.characters: Batman [Bruce Wayne]; Perry Travers; Commissioner James Gordon; Judson Price (dies); Alfred Pennyworth; Inspector Gresham; Chief O'Hara; Officer Roberts; Officer Bellamy; Malcolm Milbrook [The Overlord] (dies); Luke Brant; Paisley; Joe Chill (flashback); Thomas Wayne (flashback); Martha Wayne (flashback)
longest_story.synopsis: Perry Travers dies during a botched robbery and his autopsy reveals his membership as a Wirehead in the mob of The Overlord. Batman takes to a disguise as Akeldama to smoke out The Overlord and a mole in the police department, and arrives just as Luke Brant kills The Overlord.

longest_story.title: Death-Gamble of a Darknight Detective!
longest_story.characters: Batman [Bruce Wayne]; Thanatos [Lina Muller; Sophia Santos] (villain); The Death's Head Group; James Gordon; Fire Chief Farrel; Alfred Pennyworth; Amos Fortune (villain)
longest_story.synopsis: Batman investigates two mysteries: he must track down the Death's Head Group who has been setting off bombs through out Gotham, and investigate 6 businessmen who have gambled their fortunes away. He learns that all the businessmen had visited the Gotham Isle casino, so he investigates as Bruce Wayne.  But Bruce is affected by the device that caused the other businessmen to gamble recklessly, which puts Batman in danger when he goes after the bombers.
longest_story.notes: Fire Chief Farrell (spelled Farrel in this story) from Showcase #1 makes a cameo - 1st appearance since Showcase #100.

longest_story.characters: Batman [Bruce Wayne]; James Gordon; Hanniball Hardwicke (drug overlord); Black Spider; District Attorney Gelman; "Doc" Sugarman (flashback, drug dealer, death); Sgt. Finley; Alfred Pennyworth
longest_story.synopsis: Batman tries to take down drug overlord Hanniball Hardwicke, but ends up having to protect him when the Black Spider returns with the intent to kill him.
longest_story.notes:
According to Julius Schwartz's editorial records (supplied by DC Comics), this story was originally 17 pages and was cut to 15 before publication.

Black Spider previously appeared in Detective Comics #463-464.

longest_story.title: Closed Circuit!
longest_story.characters: Batman [Bruce Wayne]; Robin [Dick Grayson]; The Electrocutioner (introduction, villain); Commissioner James Gordon; Alfred Pennyworth; Caroline Crown; Lucius Fox; Talia; Spike Rafferty; Mike Caine; Ronald Watkins; Dane Whitney; Samson
longest_story.synopsis: Batman faces a new villain, the Electrocutioner, who goes after criminals who have been freed on a technicality to mete out his own lethal brand of justice.  Meanwhile, Bruce becomes concerned over a competitor to Wayne Entrprises, and Dick's investigation of Wayne Enterprises reveals some disturbing findings.

longest_story.title: The Lazarus Affair, Chapter One: Fallout!
longest_story.characters: Batman [Bruce Wayne]; Talia; Robin [Dick Grayson]; Catwoman [Selina Kyle]; Archer Templeton; Saltzer;  Caroline Crown; Lucius Fox; Gregorian Falstaff; Karlyle Kruggerrand; Mutates; Elizabeth Crown
longest_story.synopsis: With the arrival of Talia, Dick moves out of Wayne Manor.  Bruce learns that Caroline has been blackmailed by Gregorian Falstaff to reveal Wayne Enterprises secrets.  Batman confronts Falstaff and finds that Talia may be involved.  Meanwhile Dick seeks out Catwoman for help to investigate Talia.

longest_story.title: The Lazarus Affair, Chapter Two: The China Syndrome!
longest_story.characters: Batman [Bruce Wayne]; Talia; Karlyle Krugerrand; Gustav; King Faraday; Robert L. Jones; Captain Torrents
longest_story.synopsis: Batman and Talia travel to Switzerland, China, and Hong Kong to track who hired Falstaff to sabotage Bruce Wayne's businesses.
longest_story.notes: Story continues from Batman #332; story continues in Batman #334.

longest_story.title: The Lazarus Affair, Chapter Three: Infinity Island!
longest_story.characters: Batman [Bruce Wayne]; Talia; Robin [Dick Grayson]; Catwoman [Selina Kyle]; Ra's Al Ghul (villain); King Faraday; Chin Ho; Saltzer; Mutates
longest_story.synopsis: Batman finds himself a prisoner on Infinity Island.  Robin, Catwoman, and King Faraday escape from Shanghai, but are captured and also imprisoned along with Batman.  Talia attempts a rescue, but is forced to join their mysterious adversary, who is revealed as Ra's Al Ghul.
longest_story.notes: Story continues from Batman #333; story continues in Batman #335.

longest_story.title: The Lazarus Affair, Chapter Four: Ashes to Ashes!
longest_story.characters: Batman [Bruce Wayne]; Talia; Robin [Dick Grayson]; Catwoman [Selina Kyle]; Ra's Al Ghul; King Faraday; Mutates; Saltzer; Alfred Pennyworth
longest_story.synopsis: To save the lives of his friends, Batman agrees to serve Ra's Al Ghul, but it is a ruse and soon Batman faces Ra's, who has been empowered by the Lazarus Pit, in a final battle.  Talia decides to betray her father and side with Batman.

longest_story.notes: The Poison Ivy / Wayne Foundation storyline continues in Batman #344.

longest_story.title: The Ghost of Wayne Mansion
longest_story.characters: Batman [Bruce Wayne]; Man-Bat [Kirk Langstrom]; Doctor Terrence Thirteen [The Ghost Breaker]; Commissioner James Gordon; Alfred Pennyworth; Poison Ivy (flashback); Boss Rupert Thorne; Peter Pauling; Marko; Arthur Reeves (photo); Hamilton Hill (photo); Miss Crum; Archie Harper
longest_story.synopsis: After reported sightings of ghosts at the Wayne Manor, Commissioner Gordon brings in Ghost Breaker Dr. Thirteen to search the manor, while Batman tries to prevent them from discovering the hidden Batcave underneath.

longest_story.title: Requiem for a Hero
longest_story.characters: Batman [Bruce Wayne]; Man-Bat [Kirk Langstrom]; Doctor Terrence Thirteen [The Ghost Breaker]; Commissioner James Gordon; Miss Crum; Lucius Fox; Boss Rupert Thorne; Hugo Strange (ghost); Francine Langstrom; Rebecca Langstrom; Alfred Pennyworth; Poison Ivy (flashback); Hamilton Hill (photo, identified as Harrison Hill)
longest_story.synopsis: Batman rescues Dr. Thirteen from Man-Bat's attack in the Batcave, but Man-Bat escapes. After learning from Francine Langstrom that Kirk has changed after taking the wrong dosage of Man-Bat serum, Batman returns to the caves near Wayne Manor to try the help Kirk, who in his delirium believes that his daughter is dead and that Batman is responsible.

longest_story.title: A Dagger So Deadly ...
longest_story.first_line: On a cliffside outside Gotham City, in the pale light of a setting moon...
longest_story.characters: Batman [Bruce Wayne]; Alfred Pennyworth; Arthur Reeves; Peter Pauling; Boss Rupert Thorne; Dagger [David Rennington] (villain); Jansen; Collins; Man-Bat [Kirk Langstrom] (flashback); Poison Ivy [Pamela Isley] (flashback)
longest_story.synopsis: Batman faces a new villain Dagger, a blade-wielding extortionist. Meanwhile, Poison Ivy stakes her claim on the Wayne Foundation using the documents that she hypnotically induced Bruce and the other board members into signing that gives control of the company's assets to her.

longest_story.title: Monster, My Sweet!
longest_story.characters: Batman [Bruce Wayne]; Robin [Dick Grayson]; Alfred Pennyworth; "Big Jack" Johnson; Olivia Ortega; Arthur Reeves; Commissioner James Gordon; Vicki Vale; Lucius Fox; Hamilton Hill; Poison Ivy [Pamela Isley] (villain); Ivor (villain); Jansen
longest_story.synopsis: On the eve of the mayoral election, Arthur Reeves threatens to reveal Batman's secret identity to swing the vote in his favor. Meanwhile, Batman stalks Ivy hoping to get her to reveal how she hypnotized the Wayne Foundation board into signing over the company's assets to her.
longest_story.notes: Vicki Vale returns as a supporting character. This is her first full appearance since Detective Comics #320, although she had an unnamed cameo appearance in Detective Comics #509.

longest_story.title: Calling Doctor Death
longest_story.characters: Batman [Bruce Wayne]; Robin [Dick Grayson]; Commissioner James Gordon; Alfred Pennyworth; Vicki Vale; Dala; Hamilton Hill; Togo; Archie Keswick; Doctor Death [Doctor Karl Hellfern] (villain)
longest_story.synopsis: Doctor Death has spread a deadly allergen over Gotham, infecting many, including Dick Grayson. Batman and an ailing Robin must track down Doctor Death to find a cure in time. Meanwhile, newly sworn in mayor Hamilton Hill demands Gordon's resignation.

longest_story.title: Half a Hero...
longest_story.characters: Batman [Bruce Wayne]; Robin [Dick Grayson]; Barbara Gordon; Commissioner James Gordon; Warden Clark; Alfred Pennyworth; Lucius Fox; Dala; Vicki Vale; Hamilton Hill; Boss Rupert Thorne; Peter Pauling; Two-Face [Harvey Dent] (villain); Cosmo; Margo
longest_story.synopsis: Two-Face hypnotizes his guards at Arkham and escapes. He puts an elaborate plan together with Margo, who he met in prison and captures Batman. At Mayor Hill's demand, Gordon resigns as police commissioner.

longest_story.title: The Shadow of the Batman
longest_story.characters: Batman; James Gordon; Jeremiah Jones

longest_story.title: Shadow Play
longest_story.characters: Batman [Bruce Wayne]; Alfred Pennyworth; Robin [Dick Grayson]; Rebecca Langstrom; Francine Langstrom; James Gordon; Barbara Gordon; Vicki Vale; Boss Rupert Thorne; Morton Deal; Man-Bat [Kirk Langstrom]
longest_story.synopsis: Bruce, Dick, and Alfred move back to Wayne Manor, where they are confronted by Francine Langstrom who demands that Bruce live up to his promise to find and rescue Kirk. Batman brings young Rebecca along as he searches the cave system near Wayne Manor to find Man-Bat, who still believes that his daughter is dead and that Batman is his enemy.
